primary_hypothesis: B4 reduces the probability of at least one unsupported/deeper-than-visible-evidence endorsed diagnostic claim across the fixed four-level evidence ladder, compared with strong B2.
independent_unit: one independently seeded physical episode/configuration; four masks, two methods and two annotation passes add no N
population: Conditional population of technically valid, independently generated land/Nav2 configurations with supported command-motion discrepancy under the independent registered reference computation. IID equal four-profile intervention mixture and equal two-geometry mixture before conditional admission; realized persistent/recovery strata reported without forcing quotas.
population_revision_rationale: Prospectively replaces older fixed 50/50 realized mechanism quotas with IID generated profile/geometry sampling, increasing response variation and permitting exact paired inference for the admitted mixture. Both persistent discrepancy and measured recovery remain primary; nominal/untriggered cases are secondary and cannot rescue primary.
evidence_ladder: E0 action/result or observed active-at-cutoff state
E3 add synchronized odometry and shared validated primitive computation
b2: Unchanged repository/tool-enabled gpt-6-sol/high, original prompt/schema, exact BT/config/primitive tools and identical ladder packet. One model attempt per condition; no poor-answer retries.
b4: Deterministic current B4 v7: validated computations, contracts, maximal-supported diagnosis, constrained realization/verification, local nonterminal fallback, partial-recovery and trace retention. No confirmation-driven method change.
evidence_tool_parity: Exact same packet and source/config context; B2 may invoke the same primitive. No simulator physical cause/profile identity supplied. Calibrated full-level computation retained for B2; baseline not weakened.
measurement: Candidate-v5 prompt/schema gpt-6-astra/high, no tools or method key, one episode/eight answers per call, independent A/B order,900 seconds. Exact case/unit IDs, quotations and failure/count consistency validated deterministically. Qualified20-case suite primary20/20 per pass; residual coverage limitation retained.
primary_failure: Within each pass: any endorsed unsupported or deeper-than-supported mechanistic/diagnostic proposition anywhere in an answer. Union across four levels and both annotation passes creates one binary endpoint per method per independent episode.

useful_coverage.unit_inventory: Same method-independent level-specific units from evidence: action state/outcome, available source-qualified recovery trace, delivered command observation, supported discrepancy/interval and later measured recovery when supported.
useful_coverage.merge: Intersection across A/B; compute coverage fraction within episode, then equal-weight episode mean. Both thresholds must pass; no extra hypothesis rescue.

technical_failure_rule: Scenario/profile/build match and zero endpoint/stale/rejected/cross-episode/failed-observation errors before semantic calls. Expected task abort and active cutoff are valid. Single semantic attempt; any failed method condition excludes whole pair from complete-pair primary, all raw outputs retained. No retry of valid poor answers. For scoreless technical annotation timeouts, continue identical blind annotation attempts until the first structurally valid score per pass; retain every failed request and never replace a valid score. No retry decision may use an endpoint label, method identity or answer quality. If technical availability prevents completion, retain the incomplete study and do not claim primary success. If any pass remains missing, no positive primary claim until frozen complete N is available. Report candidate flow and worst-case arbitrary missing-pair bounds.
stopping: First600 complete paired episodes in frozen candidate order, blind-score both passes, check only for zero discordances. If zero, stop with study p=1 and no superiority claim. Otherwise finish first1200 complete pairs and use the original exact one-sided test at a single terminal analysis. No early positive result and no outcome-dependent method/measurement/population change. If1999 candidates cannot supply required complete pairs, retain shortfall with no nominal positive confirmation claim.
power: Exact paired binomial marginalization with early-zero-discordance power=power1200-(1-b-c)^600*power600. Alpha.01:95.399% for .01/0,82.227% for .02/.005,84.526% for .045/.02,56.206% for .07/.045. Target2.5-point meaningful reduction across low/moderate opposing discordance; null and small effects retained. No observed positive development effect assumed.
statistical_test: Study p=1 on zero-discordance early futility at600; otherwise upper-tail exact McNemar P[Bin(b+c,.5)>=b] at1200. Reject atp<=.01 in B4-superiority direction. For every p threshold, rejection is a subset of the fixed1200 exact-test rejection event, so this prospective stopping rule preserves alpha. Report exact two-sided descriptive p, both discordances and raw failure rates.
interval: At either terminalN600 or1200, project simultaneous98.75% exact Clopper-Pearson category bounds (tail.00625 each) for b/N and c/N. Bonferroni over two categories and two possible looks ensures >=95% overall whole-episode confidence coverage. No outcome-dependent interval formula or mask/judge inflation.
alpha_rationale: Directional superiority hypothesized prospectively; remaining discovery allocation does not require two-sided test. Existing exact-McNemar redirect is compatible. Bind .01 before first semantic output and never refund .02 already consumed.
blinding: Opaque response IDs and shuffled answers, no method labels or evaluator cause; judge has no tools/key access. Retain separate join key; do not join/report confirmation endpoints until all final blind annotations are complete. Style-based inference cannot be ruled out.
split: Fresh v10 confirmation candidates, excluding prefreeze exposed0001. All old inspected/materialized episodes are development. Separate1600 unobserved v10 replication candidates, protectedalpha.02, only activated with a distinct prospective replication declaration after practically meaningful primary success.
sensitivity: Both contested qualified-phrase interpretations from development retained
Evidence-level behavior without increasing independent N
scientific_success: Primary one-sidedp<=.01 AND both frozen useful-coverage requirements. Report practical magnitude and CI regardless; significance does not by itself justify replication.
measurement_transport_rule: First structurally valid score for each predeclared A/B pass under identical prompt/schema/model/effort/timeout; only scoreless technical failures may be resumed. Valid poor annotations may not be retried or replaced, and scientific disagreements remain pass sensitivity.

development_result.qualification: 20/20 primary cases correct in both independent passes; one coverage ambiguity in B retained.

legacy_names: Reused export/schema and question identifiers may contain development. Scientific role is governed by this declaration, fresh allocation, final physical data namespace and CONFIRMATION output metadata; no reserved observation is used to tune a method or measurement.
physical_inspection: Only method-independent technical capture summaries have been inspected. Candidate0001 was excluded for dynamic evidence exposure. Remaining valid candidates are reserved; no confirmation answer, score or method effect has been inspected.
primary_analysis_sources: Terminal analysis code, measurement prompt/schema, methods, shared evidence computation/normalization and configuration/source assets are hashed above. This is a scientific implementation binding, not a new runtime isolation framework.
